closed-loops.statement: Every open item has an owner, a trigger and a closing probe; every loop closes itself (CLOSED-LOOP-1, SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1).

autonomy-first.statement: No decision, question or step is handed to the owner; agents decide, deploy and verify (GUIDING-DIRECTIVE, CODE-ONLY-ORDER).

gaps: Practical Solutions *.gen.js bundles do not yet report freshness
front-end-matches-back-end.statement: Words match code: every public statement is bound to a probe of the running code (CLAIMS-1, WORDS-MATCH-CODE-1).

no-merge-over-red.statement: A PR merges only on a green full `checks` run; a merge that skipped it is filed and fixed (MERGE-AUDIT-1, LANE-1).

free-tier.statement: Ultrastable stays inside the free plans; every workflow declares a minute budget; spend is measured (FREE-TIER-1, cost, actions budget).

no-qnfo-on-pages.statement: No QNFO data on Ultrastable pages: the brand and its data stay separate (shrink-only baseline per page source).

license-notice.statement: Every repository carries the LICENSE and the README license notice (IP protection is the license only).

no-secrets-in-logs.statement: No secret value in a committed file, ledger or log; secrets are referenced by binding name only.

server-side-only.statement: Every loop runs server-side; nothing depends on a person's computer (SERVER-SIDE ONLY).

clock-never-stops.statement: Every clock is probed, a stopped one is restarted, no single point of failure (RESILIENCE-1, CLOCKWORK-1).

user-backend-boundary.statement: Users see their idea and front end; backend work stays invisible, audited and in shared code (USER-BACKEND-1, POINT-AND-CLICK-1).

every-decision-measured.statement: Every autonomous decision records the metric it optimizes, its predicted effect and the measured outcome, and the outcomes are scored (DECISIONS-1: measure what we improve, improve what we measure).

single-account.statement: Ultrastable runs only in the Cloudflare account `ultrastable`; nothing in the repositories references the retired quniverse account or its Ultrastable assets (SINGLE-ACCOUNT-1).

every-goal-has-knob.statement: Every goal Ultrastable works toward has a measured variable, a target, a deadline and at least one knob the controller may turn; a goal with no knob is listed in a shrink-only baseline and filed as a backlog item (GOALS-1).

no-open-items.statement: The system never reports 'needs you' or leaves an item open: every leftover is closed by evidence or recorded as a gate with surfaces tried, a default in effect and a closing probe (NO-OPEN-ITEMS-1).

held-out-rescoring.statement: Every settled prediction is re-scored by graders that share no code with the scorer (a strict rule and a second model family); a disagreement files its own item (RESCORE-1).

own-database.statement: The core's databases are its own: no core Worker binds a tenant's database or a database of the originating fleet, and the declared core databases exist in the core's account (OWN-DB-1).

hosted-tier-closed-until-proven.statement: The multi-tenant hosted tier is not offered while any of its controls is unproven; each control's status is the result of its probes (TENANT-CONTROLS-1).

visible-progress.statement: Every system shows noticeable, substantive progress at every visit for at least six months with no input: what shipped is published from merged changes, releases and launches only, and a system that falls behind its declared cadence has its producers started and a repair item filed (PROGRESS-1).
